caption:
PROVISIONAL: 3 lines still running. One marker per seed. Bar: 26.3 of 106 held-out theorems that need classical proof by
contradiction (σ, Dan's strict set), as E32 (the expected number a 32-sample draw solves), the median of our three S1g3 bases before
RL. y: (6 × trained + 2 × sampled tokens) ÷ (6 × Stage-1 tokens), prompt prefill excluded. Filled: first crossing, interpolated in
log y between checkpoints; ▼: at the first checkpoint (an upper bound); hollow: at the bar before RL; ▲ on a thin line: not reached
by that y (open: still running, 3 lines); cross on a dotted line: the recipe's think-ban guard ended the line there (censored;
counted as not reached by that y, the conservative reading, since excluding it would flatter the arm). Colour: GRPO with
programmatic thinking traces on our pool (39.5–44.5 % of targets σ-covered); black edge: the same GRPO on Dan's 4,495 EI targets
(2.7 %); grey: Dan's T1 expert-iteration ladders on this y (his own x adds re-read state prefill and replay: 1.5–1.9 × these values
after round 1; round 1, sampling only, is drawn on the floor). Differences from Dan: GRPO, not EI; a thinking model (programmatic
search traces); no pretraining replay; S1g3 bases (σ 2.48 %, not 10.9 %); doses of 0.1 % and 1.0 % of the proofs; ko has no σ
proofs, but 0.41 % of its records plan the σ detour in their narration at the effort level the bases trained on; ko_strict removes
the 949 records with such a plan at any level.
